answer.reason: The marked verses mention Kenaz only as the father of Othniel and Seraiah, and everything done in them is Othniel's, so they say no more than the summary already does.
doubts: JDG 3:9 and JDG 3:11 also name Kenaz only as Othniel's father; the deeds there belong to Othniel.
The Kenaz in 1CH 4:15, a son of Elah, appears in an unmarked verse and may be a different person; it was not used.
